node.title: Certified per-prime value-set LOWER bounds at the crossing scale (the knife-edge core)
node.statement: For a knife-edge row (specific p): certify |{e1(B) mod p}| > B* by exhibiting a provably all-pairs-distinct class family of size > B*. Collision-monotonicity makes the safe side free; THIS is the entire hard half. Per-prime (almost-all-primes tools do not apply); sampling unreachable at N' >= 128.
node.attack_surface: compose pairwise height-certified distinctness (norm < p => no collision) into large families: a packing/coding problem in the swap metric — minimum-swap-distance families whose difference heights stay below p, or a smarter invariant certifying blocks at once
node.falsifier: n/a (a construction target; its absence just leaves knife-edge rows undecided)
